occasion_label: Single assessment conducted over two sessions
notes: Analytic N=973 after exclusions; only participants completing both sessions entered analysis (PDF pp.10-11). The final age range was 18-49 despite intended recruitment at 18-32, so the broad mixed-adult convention is used. Gender: 51.3% female and 45.7% male; remaining participants reported another category or preferred not to state. The two sessions measured different constructs, not repeated SEB waves. BESSI-96 form type follows the existing legacy classification. Data/reported Pearson matrices remain to be retrieved/extracted; no effect sizes coded.
